name: bg-image-texture
blurb: Applies a subtle repeating texture pattern overlay to any background.
description: Static texture overlay component supporting five preset textures (fabric-of-squares, grid-noise, inflicted, debut-light, groovepaper) with adjustable opacity. Renders texture as an aria-hidden element.
use_when: Adding tactile texture to solid-color sections without animation overhead.
avoid_when: Complex animated backgrounds, or when texture PNG assets are unavailable.
a11y: Texture overlay marked as aria-hidden=true; children handle their own accessibility.
